docs.pricing: Marketplace prices are informational. Billing sums integer nano-USD line items, applies one exact decimal multiplier, and truncates once at final scaling. One shared bucket covers all public API paths for each trusted-proxy client IP. It refills at 60 requests per minute, allows a burst of 20, keeps at most 10,000 client buckets, and evicts buckets idle for 120 seconds. Production uses one public application process unless a gateway or shared atomic store applies the same global limit.
